theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), MeasurableSet M → CountablyRectifiable (n + 1) M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[n + 1] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → LipschitzWith L f → ∃ (ψ : ℕ → Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (V Y : ℕ → Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (F : ℕ → Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ), (∀ j, IsOpen (V j) ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 (ψ j) ∧ InjOn (ψ j) (V j) ∧ (∀ y ∈ V j, Injective (fderiv ℝ (ψ j) y)) ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 (F j) ∧ MeasurableSet (Y j) ∧ IsCompact (closure (Y j)) ∧ closure (Y j) ⊆ V j ∧ ψ j '' Y j ⊆ M ∧ (∀ y ∈ Y j, f (ψ j y) = F j y) ∧ ∀ y ∈ Y j, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt (n + 1) M (ψ j y) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (ψ j) y : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))) ∧ Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (ψ i '' Y i) (ψ j '' Y j)) ∧ μHE[n + 1] (M \ ⋃ j, ψ j '' Y j) = 0
